label: preparing
what: A surprise service jubilee for the mayor in the great hall on day 1 at 18:00, with 200 fresh loaves replacing spoiled bread, lantern lighting, and a discreet escort under the explanation of a lighting inspection. Baker knowingly helped by agreeing to keep the occasion private and supplying 80 loaves for barter. No evidence secretary or neighbour knowingly helped conceal or prepare the jubilee; mayor was told of a lighting inspection, not the celebration.
